sloka: स तु निहतरिपुः स्थिरप्रतिज्ञः स्वजनबलाभिवृतो रणे रराज ।रघुकुलनृपनन्दनो महौजास्त्रिदशगणैरभिसंवृतो यथेन्द्रः ।। ६.१११.३४ ।।
transliteration: sa tu nihataripuḥ sthirapratijñaḥ svajanabalābhivṛto raṇe rarāja ।raghukulanṛpanandano mahaujāstridaśagaṇairabhisaṁvṛto yathendraḥ ।। 6.111.34 ।।

translations.english: Then all of them (hosts of gods) coming together, accompanied by Lakshmana, Sugriva, Vibheeshana, and Angada along with other friends, happy about the victory in the battle offered prayers to charming Sri Rama in accordance with tradition.
